title: ID0412829-DC/Si-D/MC-[beTE7Z] Multiple issues
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Multiple issues
Solution:
Hello, Following preventive maintenance on the site, the technician noticed that the screen was completely off. He has carried out the usual checks: screen power supply voltage, all connections are OK. The terminal was switched off and then switched on several times, but the screen never came on. Can you arrange for the screen to be replaced, with guaranteed parts and labor? I look forward to hearing from you. There is also a problem with the tightening of the cable in the extensible support where a plastic is missing to tighten it properly. I enclose the photo. CBID : DESA
